title: Partial Tax Deferral Now Available for Qualifying Mergers and Divisions
seo_title: Partial Deferral for Mergers and Divisions: New Rules
standfirst: STA Announcement No. 13 of 2026 ends the sixteen-year all-or-nothing rule: qualifying mergers and divisions may apply special tax treatment to part of the transaction and defer tax on the consenting slice, but only where resident-enterprise shareholders aggregating more than 50 percent consent, every mandatory cohort holder joins that consensus, and for twelve months thereafter the tests continue to hold.
homepage_excerpt: Qualifying mergers and divisions may now defer tax on the consenting slice where resident-enterprise agreement exceeds 50 percent — if every mandatory holder joins and the 12-month tests hold.
meta_description: STA Announcement No. 13 of 2026 allows partial deferral for qualifying mergers/divisions above 50% consent, with mandatory cohorts and 12-month tests.
